method: Fresh global similarity from whole-bone bounds centers, followed by one rigid regional point-to-surface fit per anatomical cohort. Fixed global scale. Every fourth sorted regional control held out of regional optimization. 90% nearest-point trimming within each fitting bone. No candidate geometry participates in fitting. Positive determinant only.
